scientific_observations: With the demonstration the plan reaches the goal region (final reward 0.343); the data-free run of the same seed stays inside the U-shaped obstacle with reward 0. This is the qualitative behaviour the paper reports for car2d with and without demonstration; the paper's numbers were not compared here.

Reading of mbd/envs/car2d.py:89-93 (not a separate measurement): the step reward is nonzero only within 0.2 of the goal, so a mean of 0.343 over 50 steps means the car spends roughly the last third of the horizon at the goal.
limitations: One environment, one seed, script defaults. Printed values have three significant digits.
